description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'SuiteEditorSettings' that manages and extends editor-related configuration settings, including properties like content, textarea ID, element ID, width, group, and a JavaScript click handler. It includes a constructor that initializes the settings and an 'extend' method to update properties from provided configurations. The file also includes licensing and licensing-related documentation.

classes.name: SuiteEditorSettings
classes.description: An abstract class for managing editor configuration settings, allowing for initialization and extension of settings such as content, IDs, width, group, and click handler.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the settings object, optionally extending it with provided configuration.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Method to extend or update the current settings with properties from an input array or object.
